title: Run an AI-native ops team
description: Sort your inbox, get a daily brief, transcribe meetings, and collect receipts.
introduction: Ops work is a thousand small things across a hundred tabs: the inbox, the calendar, the project tool, and the vendor portal that logs you out every single week.
Strawberry works in all of them, right in the browser, and remembers where things stand. The small things get done, and you get to work on the things only you can do.

items.title: Why a browser, not a chatbot

blocks.text: Not sure where to start? Strawberry is free to download. Ask your companion to look at your work and suggest the first thing worth handing over.

skill.context: Ask your companion to look at your work and suggest the first thing to hand over.

blocks.text: Every morning, mail is labeled, junk is archived, and what matters is flagged.
Today's meetings, open threads, and overnight changes in one note.

demo.title: Daily brief
steps: Read today's calendar and 3 project boards

blocks.text: No bot needed. Action items go to the right people afterwards.
Find the promises nobody followed up on, and draft the nudge.

demo.prompt: What did we promise people this week that nobody followed up on?

blocks.text: Invoices downloaded from every portal into one register.

demo.prompt: Collect every invoice from September for the bookkeeper

sections.title: Why a browser, not a chatbot

blocks.text: Most ops work is clicking through websites. That's what Strawberry does.

items: Works in any logged-in tool or portal, API or not.
Routines keep running while you're away.

blocks.text: In our test of 12 real-world tasks, Strawberry scored 99.2 out of 100. Perplexity's Comet scored 90.8 and ChatGPT Atlas 73.3.

items: Write the weekly status update from project tools, meetings, and messages.
Plan and book a trip or an event, booking only what you approve.
Onboard a new teammate: accounts, docs to read, and people to meet.
Create Slack channels and invite the right people.

blocks.text: The team workspace gives people and companions one shared place for notes, docs, and handoffs. Put the recurring work on Routines and it keeps happening when someone is on holiday.
